convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to call 'BlauCMI' custom indicator and depends on two external .mqh libraries (SmoothAlgorithms.mqh, TradeAlgorithms.mqh) for smoothing algorithms and trade execution logic

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator calculation
TimeShiftSec - chart period in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for trade signal timing

other_exits: Signal-based close: long closed when BlauCMI[1]>BlauCMI[2] (declining indicator), short closed when BlauCMI[1]<BlauCMI[2] (rising indicator), gated by BuyPosClose/SellPosClose input flags

position_sizing.conditional_logic: If MM is negative, treated as fixed lot size; if positive, treated as share of deposit (deposit fraction). MMMode selects between LOT and FROZEN_MARGIN methods via TradeAlgorithms.mqh

custom_logic_notes: Entry logic uses 3-bar comparison of BlauCMI values: Value[0] (SignalBar), Value[1] (SignalBar+1), Value[2] (SignalBar+2). Long condition: Value[1]<Value[2] AND Value[0]>Value[1] - indicator was declining then reversed upward. Short condition: Value[1]>Value[2] AND Value[0]<Value[1] - indicator was rising then reversed downward. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose input booleans gate entry and exit permissions independently. Signal timing uses SERIES_LASTBAR_DATE + TimeShiftSec for trade synchronization. LoadHistory() called each tick for proper IsNewBar operation. Validation: IPC1==IPC2 && XLength==1 causes INIT_FAILED.
python_conversion_notes: BlauCMI is a custom indicator requiring reimplementation in Python. It uses triple-smoothed momentum (CMI = Cumulative Momentum Index by William Blau). The smoothing algorithm (CXMA) supports multiple methods (EMA, JJMA, VIDIA, AMA) via SmoothAlgorithms.mqh - must replicate the selected method (default EMA). The TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose with built-in position checks, deviation handling, and margin-based lot calculation - must replicate these wrappers. Position sizing logic is conditional on MM sign (negative=fixed lot, positive=deposit fraction). Signal logic compares 3 consecutive indicator values for momentum reversal detection. New bar guard prevents multiple entries per bar.
